title: Delegation follow-up: classify persistent filesystem errors in the worktree owner check as refusals, not retries
outcome: A persistent filesystem error in the follow-up owner check (for example InvalidFilename or FilesystemLoop from a hand-made `.git`) refuses the follow-up with 'start a new delegation' instead of 'retry shortly', or the Unreadable message tells the parent to start a new delegation if retries keep failing.
acceptance: Delegation follow-up: classify persistent filesystem errors in the worktree owner check as refusals, not retries is done
